Results

Hover a cell for its exact value, unit and basis.

How to read it. The submitted paper's Table 4, rebuilt from the new design (the run set is chosen at the top). Each row is an intervention, and each coloured cell is its response in one region (North or South) for the intervening region and policy chosen above: the mean over periods 79–100 of the run's difference from its own baseline. Units are in the column header: % is a percentage deviation, pp a change in percentage points, % VA a share of the region's baseline value added. Green is a rise and red a fall, except in the columns marked ▼ better (emissions, extraction, water, land, public debt/GDP), where the colours are reversed. Colour is relative within each column; by default the column maximum is over the 12 rows shown, and over all runs of the chosen set it stays comparable when you switch. The chip before each intervention's name is its value-added regime in the run shown; all of them are in the Regimes tab. Regimes are read by role: the intervening region against its partner (for "both intervene", North against South). South emissions are corrected (D-77).

Grid. 180 runs: twelve interventions (sc1-sc12, a 20% substitution from period 70) x who intervenes (North, South, both) x five policies, North/South world under OPENFIX-fiat. Each response is the mean over periods 79-100 of the run's difference from its own no-intervention baseline. South emissions corrected ex post (D-77). Analysis tag 20261121_ce79; no simulation is run by this page.
